run_get_flops: run the get_flops script to calculate FLOPs and parameters for a detector model config
run_inference_flops: run the inference function to compute model FLOPs using a dataloader and config file
parse_args_flops: parse command line arguments for the get_flops tool including config path and num images
review_inference: review the inference function that builds a model from config and calculates average FLOPs
summarize_get_flops: summarize the get_flops tool that analyzes detector model complexity using mmengine analysis utilities
